schema.name: PQReadiness_CL
schema.description: Post-quantum cryptography readiness findings from QCrypton PQC Scanner. Contains scan results for Key Vault keys, TLS certificates, App Service TLS config, Storage Account encryption, and CMK provenance.

columns.name: TimeGenerated
columns.description: Timestamp when the finding was generated by the scanner.

columns.name: ResourceId
columns.description: Azure Resource Manager resource ID of the scanned resource.

columns.name: ResourceName
columns.description: Display name of the scanned Azure resource.

columns.name: SubscriptionId
columns.description: Azure subscription ID containing the resource.

columns.name: ResourceGroup
columns.description: Resource group containing the scanned resource.

columns.name: Location
columns.description: Azure region of the scanned resource.

columns.name: AssetKind
columns.description: Classification of the cryptographic asset (kv-key, kv-cert, tls-cert, tls-config, storage-encryption, cmk).

columns.name: AssetIdentifier
columns.description: Unique identifier for the specific cryptographic asset (e.g., Key Vault key URI, certificate thumbprint).

columns.name: Algorithm
columns.description: Cryptographic algorithm in use (e.g., RSA, EC, ML-KEM).

columns.name: KeySize
columns.description: Key size in bits (e.g., 2048, 4096). Null for non-key assets.

columns.name: Curve
columns.description: Elliptic curve name if applicable (e.g., P-256, P-384). Null for non-EC keys.

columns.name: SignatureAlgorithm
columns.description: Signature algorithm of the certificate (e.g., SHA256WithRSA, ECDSAWithSHA384).

columns.name: QuantumPosture
columns.description: Quantum readiness posture: vulnerable, partial, or quantum-safe.

columns.name: PostureReason
columns.description: Human-readable explanation for the quantum posture classification.

columns.name: RiskScore
columns.description: Numeric risk score (0-100) reflecting quantum vulnerability severity.

columns.name: ExpiresOn
columns.description: Expiry date of the certificate or key. Null for non-expiring assets.

columns.name: Metadata
columns.description: Additional JSON metadata about the finding.
